title: Conditions for implementing projective measurements through continuous monitoring
summary: Projective measurements are foundational for quantum physics in general and quantum information tasks in particular. However, their direct implementation is often not warranted. Here, we investigate under what conditions continuous monitoring that manifests in quantum jump trajectories realises projective measurements over time.
